signup.welcome_body:
FREE Mode — registration required.

We'll ask for name, email, phone, and country. We'll use this information only to:
 • Confirm your identity
 • Send archprime-cli updates (opt-out anytime)
 • Enable future Premium upgrade with the same account

Your data is GDPR-protected. You can delete it with [bold]arch account delete[/bold] anytime.
signup.prompt_country: Country code ISO 3166 (e.g. US, IT, BR, ES)
signup.prompt_consent: Do you accept the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy (GDPR)?
signup.consent_required: GDPR consent is required. Signup cancelled.
signup.invalid_phone: Phone must be in international format (e.g. +14155552671).
signup.invalid_country: Country code must be 2 letters (ISO 3166 alpha-2).
signup.next_steps:
[bold green]✓ Signup complete[/bold green]

Next steps:
 1. [cyan]arch init <project>[/cyan] — create a new project
 2. [cyan]arch audit <project>[/cyan] — verify inputs
 3. [cyan]arch run dal-brief-al-cantiere[/cyan] — run workflow

Upgrade to Premium (credits included): [link]https://lovarch.com/cli-upgrade[/link]

account.no_account: No account configured. Run 'arch signup' or 'arch login'.
account.delete_warning_body:
You are about to delete your archprime-cli account (FREE mode).

What happens:
 • Your personal data (name, email, phone) will be pseudonymized (GDPR Art. 17)
 • Your token will be revoked — you won't be able to use archprime-cli with this account
 • The shadow account in Lovarch will be deleted
 • [bold]Optionally[/bold] we delete local projects in ~/.archprime/projects/

[red]This action CANNOT be undone.[/red]
account.deletion_success: ✓ Account deleted. Thanks for trying archprime-cli.
account.premium_delete_redirect:
Premium account deletion is handled in the Lovarch web app:
  https://lovarch.com/settings/account/delete
